newsitem.title: UK: European bunkers - fuel steady, diesel, gas oil ease.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers - fuel steady, diesel, gas oil ease.

text.p: European bunker fuel oil prices held steady with crude on Friday, but diesel and gas oil bunkers eased on prompt oversupply and as gas oil futures continued to slide, brokers said.
They said the general undertone continued bearish with demand from shipowners still fairly relaxed and supply at most ports good.

Diesel and gas oil bunker price falls stalled on Thursday as gas oil futures steadied, but both spot and futures markets continued to lose ground on Friday under the weight of building supplies and poor demand.

In contrast heavy fuel oil bunkers held steady with brokers reporting moderate demand in the ARA region. They said some demand had been generated by the recent firmer trend, but expected further rises to be limited by ample supplies.
NWE fuel oil bunkers were steady but prices for MDO and gas oil slipped around $3-4 per tonne.
Mediterranean markets were talked steady to slightly firmer with fuel oil bunkers at Spanish and French Med ports still seeing some quite good demand brokers said.
African bunkers continued soft on improving supplies and Mideast markets firmed with Fujairah supplies still seen tight.
